findings.detail: All four flagged source rows state SOFR plus a numeric spread, but the structured flagged value retains only SOFR.
Plains is 8.02% in the current-period row, while the flagged 8.70% comes from the comparative table.

rationale: Class 2 source-row review localizes the primary defect to structured reference/spread extraction: Luminii, Knight AcquireCo, Woven Health Collective, and Plains each disclose a combined SOFR + numeric spread cell, whereas the flagged structured value is only SOFR. The Plains full row also exposes a comparative-period leak: current table 29 row 9 reports 8.02%, while 8.70% appears at comparative table 51 row 27 and was carried into the flagged identifier.
